name: RALU three-stage mixed resolution (full read, replaces name-level ralu-staged-sampling)
plain: Starts at half resolution, then upscales only the patches with the most edges, then upscales the rest. Noise is added at each jump so the latent matches the noise level of the next stage. This saves model time because early steps run on far fewer tokens. On Flux, the mixed stage really uses fewer tokens, with half-offset position ids; on SD3 it stays a full grid with blocks repeated.
math:
Stage k: σ_lin=linspace(u(1−s_k),u(1−e_k),N_k+1), u(v)=v/(h−(h−1)v); t=hσ_lin/(1+(h−1)σ_lin); x←x+v·(t_{j+1}−t_j) (plain Euler).
s_{k+1}=e_k/(Z(1−e_k)+e_k). Jump: x←β x+α n; β=1/(Z(1−e_k)+e_k), α=1−s_{k+1}.
Stage 1 latent is nearest-downsampled by 2. Stage 2 selection: x̂₀=x−v σ, top ⌊r·patches⌋ by Canny edge sum on the VAE decode (thresholds 100,200), or energy+½|grad| on latent x̂₀ if no VAE or if it fails. Selected patches repeat ×4 in tokens.
Correlated noise option: blocks of 4 tokens with Σ=I+γ11ᵀ, γ=−1/Z²+1e-6, by Cholesky.
Flux: calls forward_orig directly, no CFG, first conditioning entry only, guidance embed default 3.5. SD3: optional cfg_scale through _predict_sd3_velocity.
Presets: level 4 N=[5,6,7], e=[.3,.45,1], Z=6.317, r=.3; level 7 N=[2,3,5], e=[.2,.3,1], Z=6.261, r=.1.

label: from code
surprise: The Flux path skips the sampling pipeline, calling forward_orig itself, so CFG, patches and ComfyUI samplers do not apply. SD3 enforce_masked_block_structure exists but the run reports structure_enforcement disabled.

audit.note: Stage update misstated. ralu_engine.py:161-165 and ralu_flux_runtime.py:517: ends are inverse-warped, linspace runs in that space, then forward-warped t_j=hσ/(1+(h−1)σ) drive the step. Euler's Δ is the warped difference, so step spacing is not linear in the applied noise level.
